paite: Hiaite David thu nanungpen ahi. Jesse tapa David, sangtak a dopsang a ompa, Jakob' Pathian thaunilhpa, Israelte la phuaktu in achi hi.
heading: David Thu Nanungte

paite: TOUPA Kha in kei hon zang in agen a, athu ka lei ah a-om hi.
Israelte' Pathian in agen a, Israelte' Suangpi'n ka kiang ah agen hi. Mi tung a vaihawmmi adik ngeingei dia Pathian lau kawm a vai ahawm ding ahi.
Amah ni ahong suah a, meipi om het lou zingsang vak bang ahi dia, vuahzuk khit a khua hong siang a lei a loupa selnou mitmet bang ahi ding ahi.
Pathian a ding in ka inkuan hiai bang hi kei mahleh, kei toh tangtawn thukhun abawl a, bangkim kizentak in ahihkip hi. Ama'n khangsak kei mahleh hiai ka hotdamna leh ka deihlam tengteng ahi.
Himahleh Belial tate bel avek un ling paihkhiak bang ahi ding uh, khut a lak theih louh ahih ziak un.
Himahleh amau khoih ding mi sik leh teipi a, akivat ding ahi. Huchi in amun mah ah hal ahi ding uh.
Hiaite David sepaih hangsante min ahi. Tekmon mi Joseph Bashebeth sepaih heutute lak a heutupa ahi a; amah khatvei thu a mi zagiat thatpa Eznit mi Adino achih mah uh ahi.
heading: David Sepaih Minthangte / (1 Kro 11.10-41)

paite: Ama zom in Ahoh tapa Dodo tapa Eleazar ahi. Amah Philistia mite kidou dia akikaihkhop ua, achou ua, Israel mite a paimang vek lai ua David kiang a sepaih hangsan thumte lak a khat ahi.
Amah athou a, Philistia mite akhut a kham matan namsau leng khah lou khop in athat hi. Huai ni in TOUPA'N nakpitak in azouta a, mite ama nung ah gallak thil la ding lel in ahong kik nawn uhi.
Amah nung in Harar mi Agee tapa Shammah ahi. Behiang tampi omna lou a Philistia mite akikaihkhop lai un, Israel mite ataikek uhi.
Himahleh amah huai mun ah adingh a, aveng a, Philistia mite athat a, TOUPA'N nakpitak in azohsak hi.
Sepaih hangsan sawmthum lak a thumte ahohsuk ua, buhlak laitak in David kiang ah Adullam kohawm ah ahoh ua; Philistia sepaihte'n Rephaim Phaizang ah panmun akhoh uh.
Huchih lai in David insung ah a-om a, huchih lai mah in Bethlehem ah Philistia sepaihte a-om uhi.
David in tui alunggulh mahmah a, "Bethlehem a tuileh tui, kulh kongkhak kiang a dawn ding hong pia om le uh aw!" achi hi.

Huchi in sepaih hangsan thumte'n Philistia sepaihte apaltan ua, kulh kongkhak kiang a Bethlehem tuileh ava tawi ua, David kiang ah apaipih uh. Himahleh ama'n ana dawn ngam kei a, TOUPA a ding in abungkhe zawta hi.
"Aw TOUPA, hiai ka hih louh ding dan; sih ngap a kuante sisan ka dawn dia hia?" achi hi. Huchi in adawn nuam kei hi. Huai thilte sepaih hangsan thumte'n ahih uh ahi.
Zeruiah tapa Joab unau Abishai thumte lak a aheutupen uh ahi. Teipi in mi zathum sual in athat a, thumte lak ah minhoih aloh hi.
Thumte lak ah pahtawi tuak pen ahi kei maw? Huaiziak in aheutu ding un abawl uhi. Himahleh tungnungpen thumte lak atung zou kei hi.
Kabzeel mihangsan tapa Jehoiada tapa Benaiah thil thupitak hihpa in Moab mi Ariel tapate nih athat a; huchi in ahohsuk a, vuk kiak hun lai in leikohawm ah humpinelkai leng ava that hi.
Aigupta mi, miliantak athat a; huai Aigupta mi in teipi atawi hi. Himahleh ama'n chiangkhun tawi in ava zuan a, Aigupta mi teipi tawi ava sut a, ama teipi in asunlumta hi.
Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in huchibang thil ahih ziak in sepaih hangsan thumte lak ah minhoih aloh hi.
Mi sawmthumte sang in pahtawi tuak ahi. Himahleh tungnungpen thumte lak a simtel ahi zou kei hi. David in amah vengtu heutu in akoih hi.
Sawmthumte lak a khat Joab unau Asahel ahi: Bethlehem a mi Dodo tapa Elhanan;
Harod mi Shammah, Harod mi Elika;
Pal mi Helez, Tekoa mi Ikkesh tapa Ira;
Anethot mi Abiezer, Hushath mi Mebunnai;
Ahoh mi Zalmon, Netophah mi Maharai
Netophah mi Baanah tapa Heleb, Benjamin suan, Gebeah a mi Ribai tapa Ittai;
Pirathon mi Benaiah, Gaash luite a mi Hidai; 31 Arbath mi Abi-albon, Barhum mi Azmaveth;
Arbath mi Abi-albon, Barhum mi Azmaveth;
Shaalbon mi Eliaba, Jashen tapate lak a Jonathan;
Harar mi Shammah, Arar mi Sharar tapa Ahiam;
Mankat mi Ahasbai tapa Eliphelet, Gilon mi Ahithophel tapa Eliam;
Karmel mi, Hezrai, Arba mi Paarai;
Zobah mi Nathan tapa Igal, Gad mi Bani;
Ammon mi Jelek, Beeroth mi Nahari, Zeruiah tapa Joab galvan tawi;
Ith mi Ira, Ith mi Gareb;
Hit mi Uriah ahi uh. Avek un sawmthum-le-sagih ahi uh.
